Why We Built an Ontology Engine Instead of Another Rules System
Every IoT platform has a rules engine. We built something different: a 252-entity OWL ontology that understands what equipment is, not just what values it reports. Traditional industrial alarm systems work like this: IF temperature > 80°C THEN alert
